Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the Wikipedia page by confusing paternal and maternal grandparents. Despite the page explicitly stating Felipe is the maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofía, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Concepción Sáenz de Tejada (his paternal grandmother) was the maternal grandmother by misaligning grandparent pairs and misreading the godparent information.
